notes.title: Update 0.8
notes.notes: This update introduces a new stage set on the brink of reality. How long can you last in this environment. And what does "long" even mean when the edges of reality begin to blur?

notes.title: Update 0.7
notes.notes:
New stage and balance changes.

List of changes:

New stage added. For those of you who have gotten really deep into the game - literally, we are adding a new stage, the Mycosphere Slopes. This level should provide a challenge even for the most veteran of Tamageddon players.
We have heard you. Progressing through Tamageddon is slow, at least in the beginning. To address this we are significantly increasing the rate at which you level up in the early game. Hopefully this will help players get to a place in the game where it opens up and you have more interesting tools at your disposal.

notes.title: Update 0.6
notes.notes:
Two new characters join the Tamageddon cast.

List of changes:

New characters added
New advancement added
Balance changes
Bug fixes

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.notes:
This update introduces the Whirling Caverns, a spelunking challenge for the most seasoned Tamageddoners. How far do these caves go?

List of changes:

New stage added
New power-ups added
Advancement ranks added
Performance improvements
Camera improvements

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.notes:
Support for XInput compatible controllers have been added!

In addition to this, the interface can now be navigated with either mouse, controller or keyboard.

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.notes: For this update we're introducing another new stage, the eighth stage so far. This is our first snowy stage. We are aware that our timing is a bit off releasing this in the middle of July, but nevertheless...enjoy!

notes.title: Update 0.2
notes.notes:
It's been almost a week since Tamageddon went into early access.

We would like to thank you all for all your feedback so far!

For this update we're introducing a new stage, the seventh stage so far. This new stage has been very popular in our internal play tests, we hope you will like it! It has kind of a platformy vibe to it. It's pretty deep into the game though, so it might take some while for you to unlock it. But keep on rolling and you'll get there :-)
